title: Iteration of the list step
statement: For any bit strings $q,w$ and natural number $i$, applying the list step $i$ times to the pair encoding $\langle q,w\rangle$ gives $\langle q,\pi_2^{[i]}(w)\rangle$, where $\pi_2$ is the total second projection and $\pi_2^{[i]}$ denotes its $i$-fold iterate.
